release.title: Title
release.packageFileHelp: Select one or more files. For an extension, select your .nupkg file. For materials or templates, select the media (images, audio, video, fonts) and JSON files — the kind follows the files, so a mix of media and JSON becomes a package carrying both. A template that references a bundled material must name a file that is also among the selected files.
